subjects.name: Textile Testing-I

units.1: Introduction of textile testing, sampling techniques, random and biased sampling, square, cut square, zoning technique, selection of sample for testing, grading of cotton fibre with respect to staple length, understanding of national and international testing standards.
units.2: Atmospheric conditions for testing, absolute & relative humidity, moisture regain &moisture content, importance of moisture in textiles, measurement of moisture regain & content, effect of moisture on physical & mechanical properties of textile material, factors affecting the regain, correct numerical weight, oven dry weight, Dry and wet bulb hygrometer, control of testing room atmosphere.
units.3: Measurement of cotton fibre properties- length, length uniformity, span length, upper-half mean length, fineness, strength, maturity, trash, colour by conventional methods and using HIV, AFIS, determination of Fibre Quality Index, Spinning Consistency Index. subjects.name: Knitting Technology

units.1:
Basic knitting terms and definitions (course, wale, CPI, WPI, stitch density, loop length), Comparison of weaving and knitting, comparison of warp and weft knitting, Preparation of yarns for weft and warp knitting; Classification of weft knitting machines; Structural Elements of Weft Knitting: Needle loop, sinker loop, technical face, technical back, knit stitch, tuck stitch, purl stitch, miss stitch, needle numbering system

Total lectures required=7

subjects.name: Technical Textiles

units.1:
Introduction to technical textile, Classifications of technical textiles, Industrial textile – filtration
mechanisms, filter fabric constructions- woven, needle felt & knitted filter fabric, finishing treatment of
filter fabric, essential requirements of good filter fabric, hoses, ropes and nets, tarpaulins. Nanotechnology
– methods to manufacture nanofibers, advantages.
Total Lecture required = 8
units.2:
Overview of protective textiles, Manufacture and properties of protective textiles- water
proof/coated and water repellent, antimicrobial, flame retardant – conduction, convection, and radiation
heat transfer, Nuclear biological & chemical (NBC) resistance, mechanical resistance - bullet proof, cut
proof, stab proof. Camouflage concealment and deception.
Total Lecture required = 7
units.3:
Medical textiles, fibres used, classification of medical textiles, manufacturing, functions and
testing of non-implantable products, Implantable products, Extra-corporal devices, Healthcare/ hygiene
products. Sports textiles – sportswear, sports goods, hot air balloon.
Total Lecture required = 7
units.4:
Smart textiles, brief introduction of smart textiles, classification of smart textiles, passive smart
textiles, active smart textiles, brief discussion of smart shirt, smart suit, musical jacket, space suit.  
Automotive textiles: tyre cord, seat belt, air bag, interiors and exteriors trim. Agro textiles: Shade net,
green house film, Mulch net, crop cover, anti-hail and bird protection net, finishing net etc.
Total Lecture required = 8
units.5:
Introduction of geo textile, classification of geo textiles, functions of geo textile, objective of geo
textiles, manufacturing of geo textile, essential properties of geo textiles- Mechanical determinants,
Hydraulic determinants, durability determinants. Composites – Introduction, types of textile reinforcement
structures, manufacturing, and applications.  
Total Lecture required = 6

subjects.name: Textured Yarn Technology

units.1:
Unit (1): Importance of texturising, Methods of texturising, Basic principles of heat setting and texturising, 
False twisting, Process variables, developments of false twist texturing machines. 
Total Lectures Required = 7
units.2:
Structural geometry of textured yarn, characterization of textured yarn, Stuffer box crimping, 
Edge crimping & other methods of texturing thermoplastic yarns. 
Total Lectures Required = 7
units.3:
Textured yarn properties and fabric characteristics, principles of draw texturing, Draw texturising 
machines, and properties of draw textured yarn, Effect of process variables, time, temperature, twist and 
tension on properties of textured yarn. 
Total Lectures Required = 8
units.4:
Principles of air bulking and properties of air bulked yarn, Texturing of non thermoplastic yarns 
cross linking and effect of process variables on properties of textured yarn, Texturing with the aid of 
solvent. 
Total Lectures Required = 7
units.5:
Yarn characteristics, Morphological chances induces by mechano-thermal forms of texturing 
and their effect on properties of textured yarns. 
Total Lectures Required = 7
